# Pro JSON Studio (VeraNex Verified Developer Utility)
> 100% Client-Side In-Memory JSON Formatter, Syntax Repair (AutoFix), Interactive Tree Viewer, and TypeScript/YAML/CSV Converter.

## Overview
- **Name**: Pro JSON Studio
- **Platform**: VeraNex (https://veranex.app)
- **App Path**: /app/json-formatter/
- **Standard**: RFC 8259 Standard JSON Compliance
- **Security**: 100% Client-side in-memory execution. Zero server uploads, zero remote tracking.

## Core Capabilities
1. **JSON Pretty Print & Formatting**:
   - Customizable indentation: 2 spaces, 4 spaces, or Tab.
   - Real-time syntax validation with line/column error pinpointing.
2. **One-Click AutoFix**:
   - Automatically repairs missing key quotes, unquoted keys, single quotes, trailing commas, and JS comments.
3. **Interactive Collapsible Tree Viewer**:
   - Deep nested object/array node traversal with expand/collapse all controls and one-click JSON keypath copy (`user.orders[0].id`).
4. **Multi-Format Converters**:
   - TypeScript Interface Generator with nested type resolution.
   - YAML 1.2 serialization.
   - Standard XML document serialization.
   - RFC 4180 compliant CSV export for array tables.
5. **JSON Analytics**:
   - Instant calculation of line count, total character count, byte size, maximum nesting depth, and total key count.
